description.en: Character-built sharks swim, hunt and bend through schools of fish on a fine grid, with pointer avoidance, splash reactions and an optional translucent local composer.
description.zh: 字符鲨鱼在细网格上摆尾游动、追逐鱼群，支持指针避让与点击惊散，并可叠加半透明本地输入框。

keywords: ASCII 字符 鲨鱼 鱼群 游动 海洋 捕食 追逐 避让 水波 网格 背景 输入框 shark ocean fish boids stacked drewdi

discovery.caveat: 本地动画与可选输入界面；语音输入需要调用方回调。

source.implementation: https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks/tree/a0074c16a106f0abc665fe9712ca445f8f98ad8e — original World, AsciiRenderer, math and species modules, MIT. LeiBox supplies the instance-scoped lifecycle and optional local UI; no original backend is included.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Move or tap the water to scatter fish. Focus the water: Space pauses, R restarts, arrows move and Enter splashes. Messages stay in local history; voice input needs a callback.
instructions.zh: 移动或轻点水面惊散鱼群。聚焦水面后，空格暂停，R重置，方向键移动，回车制造水波。输入仅保存在本地历史，语音需接入回调。
